faq.question: What is the minimum qualification for MBBS in India?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, Biology/Biotechnology and English with at least 50% marks (40% for reserved categories) and qualified NEET-UG.

faq.question: What is the difference between AIQ and State Quota?
faq.answer: 15% of all government college seats are reserved for All India Quota (counselled by MCC), while 85% are filled through respective State Government counselling authorities.
